articles.summary: C.H. Robinson extended its three-year run of market outperformance in Q3, with market share gains and Lean AI productivity fueling results. Notably, it’s largest business division, North American Surface Transportation (NAST), grew volume by 3.5% year-over-year, while the Cass Freight Shipment Index declined 0.3% over the same period. This marks the 14th consecutive quarter in which NAST year-over-year volume growth outpaced the index, reflecting continued market share gains in both truckload and LTL.
articles.title: C.H. Robinson extends three-year run of market outperformance in Q3
